Name: SVE Facelift (Portrait Mod)
Author: siamece
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0duqYSg.png[/img]

﻿﻿This mod edits each SVE portrait to smooth them out and make the artstyle consistent with my own. Credit to the Stardew Valley Expanded team for the characters & [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/2679113-poltergeister/]Poltergeister[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41168370]HopeWasHere[/url] for the original portraits!
Part of my Facelift series that also includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9097]Pet Facelift[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url].


This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded![/url] Please do not ask me for helping installing SVE.﻿
Download and unzip/extract the file into your Stardew mods folder, and it's ready to go.

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                 [/u]


[u][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/uUcgk6G.png[/img][/size][/u]
The config file will generate after you run the game, or you can use GMCM.
My edits can be turned off for any character, with "[b]true[/b]" being edited and "[b]false[/b]" being unedited. you can also choose between "true," "false", or "cute" for Magnus to use the 'cute' wizard portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift[/url].
